binary_path.label: freeclipd path
binary_path.description: Absolute path or a path starting with ~. Empty uses the bundled binary, then freeclipd on PATH.

device_address.label: Device address
device_address.description: Bluetooth address to use instead of the HUAWEI FreeClip 2 name match. Empty discovers automatically.

low_battery_notify.label: Low battery notification
low_battery_notify.description: Notify once when either earbud drops to the threshold. It arms again after the level rises 5 points.

low_battery_percent.label: Low battery threshold
low_battery_percent.description: Percent at which the bar text turns to the error color and the notification fires.

battery_style.label: Battery text
battery_style.description: Which charge level the bar shows.

show_case.label: Include the case
show_case.description: Count the case when showing the lowest level, and append it in the left/right/case layout.

hide_when_disconnected.label: Hide when disconnected
hide_when_disconnected.description: Hide the bar widget unless the daemon is starting, connecting, ready, or reconnecting.

error.binary: freeclipd was not found. Build it with make, or set its path in the plugin settings.
error.stream: The daemon stream did not start.

panel.title: FreeClip 2
panel.wearing_unknown: Unknown until the headset reports it
panel.pause_hint: Pause playback when an earbud is taken out.
panel.not_connected: The vendor channel is down. Pair and connect audio from the Bluetooth page. This plugin does not connect the headset itself.
